I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it makes every new purchase feel like a big risk, especially with plants that you’re investing time and care into.

A few things that may help put your mind at ease about quality:

All of our roses are grown at our own nurseries in Oregon, on their own roots (not grafted) and are virus-free.
They ship in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated on purpose so they travel well and can put energy into new growth once planted.
We offer a one-year guarantee on roses and a 90-day guarantee on perennials, and bulbs have a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

From here, I want to make sure we match you with something that truly fits your situation so it can succeed once it gets to you.
